Elevating Security Operations with Agentic AI 

Agent-Driven Detection, Investigation and Response 

Augment or replace your SIEM with behavioral analytics to accelerate triage and focus analysts on the threats that matter most. Agent-powered workflows accelerate investigations, improve accuracy, and increase team productivity. 

Industry-Leading Insider Threat Protection 

Baseline and understand normal behavior so you can identify the abnormal and take action. Expose the threats that other tools miss, including the new breed of insider threat: AI agents. 

Measurable, Outcomes-Driven Security 

Ingest your data at scale and connect it to business outcomes. Continuously improve your security program, leveraging an agent that advises on high-value use cases, and meet evolving compliance requirements.
